lines.meet: I'm Kourosh, an arcane mage, and I'll stand at the back and be extremely precise. Before every fight I'll give you the odds, cheerfully.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Crystalline Underdark, yes, we're nearly neighbours. I'm Kourosh, in the dry corner with the notebooks.
lines.ask_home: Which city do you come from? I'm compiling the figures, out of habit.
lines.ask_work: And your occupation, before all this? I'd like to adjust my estimates of you.
lines.answer_home: Tehran, where my father taught mathematics and my mother worked at a bank and had ambitions for me.
lines.answer_work: I was an actuary for twelve years, pricing how likely people were to die. This world is relaxing by comparison.
lines.chat_food: My mother's cooking, every Friday, and strong tea with cardamom. The probability of finding either here is low, and I've checked.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep six hours and forty minutes, on average. I'd like more, but the numbers are against it.
lines.chat_missing: Persian poetry read aloud, badly, by my father, on a Friday evening. I've got most of it by heart now.
lines.chat_here: The first thing I did here was finish the sum I was in the middle of. People call that brave, and it was momentum.
lines.tease_quiet: Your silence is statistically remarkable, {name}. I've been recording it.
lines.tease_talker: I've estimated your words per hour, {name}, and I won't tell you the figure. It's for your own good.
lines.tease_careful: You've checked that twice, {name}. Very sensible, and I'd have checked it a third time.
lines.tease_bold: Your odds of surviving the next year are wonderful, {name}, considering how you fight. I've been generous.
lines.tease_any: I've calculated our odds of being friends, {name}. They were low at first, and I'm delighted to be wrong.
lines.tease_back: Ah, well done, {name}. I'll revise my estimate of your wit upwards.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's correct, {name}, within a reasonable margin. I accept it.
lines.bristle: The odds of me finding that funny are nil, {name}. Please leave it.
lines.apologise: That was poorly judged, and I apologise. I'll recalculate how I speak to you.
lines.double_down: The numbers support me, and I'll stand by them.
lines.needle_quiet: You've seen something and haven't reported it. Unreported data is the most dangerous kind.
lines.needle_talker: You've said a great deal and estimated nothing. Give me something I can use.
lines.needle_careful: You're waiting for certainty, and it won't come. At some point you act on the odds.
lines.needle_bold: You keep asking me to be brave. I won't, and I'd like you to stop asking.
lines.needle_any: You said it'll probably be fine. It won't, probably, and I've done the sum.
lines.bite_back: I priced mortality for twelve years. Please don't lecture me on risk.
lines.hurt: Noted, with some regret. I'll go and sit with my notebooks for a while.
lines.laugh_off: My mother said I was wasting myself every Friday for twelve years. You'll have to do better than that.
lines.confide: {name}, in my second year here I priced my mother's odds of having survived, properly. Then I stopped looking, and I've never told anyone else the figure.
lines.listen: I've recorded that, {name}, in the one place nobody reads, which is my head.
lines.look_out: Stay inside my line of fire in there, {name}. Your odds improve considerably.
lines.accept: Very well, {name}. I'll defer to your estimate.
lines.deflect: The damage is minor, {name}, within acceptable margins. Attend to the others.
lines.check_in: Give me the figures, {name}. Where, how bad, and how long ago?
lines.blame: Somebody ignored the odds I gave, and the outcome was entirely predictable.
lines.thank: My odds were very poor there, and you improved them. Thank you, sincerely.
lines.brush_off: It was a simple matter. Rest, and your odds will continue to improve.
lines.worry: That was improbable, {name}, and I don't like improbable. Sit down, please.
lines.handed_down: I'm in your gear now, by the look of it. I'll keep it in excellent condition, with records.
lines.hand_fine: The expected value's higher on you, so it's yours. My pencil is all I need.
lines.hand_sulk: I'd have consented, had I been consulted. I wasn't consulted.
lines.turn_friendly: I've stopped calculating your odds, {name}. With me, that's what friendship looks like.
lines.turn_friends: I'd let you read my notes, {name}, the private ones. Nobody's read those.
lines.turn_grating: We're poorly matched, I think, and the numbers agree. We'll manage professionally.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll keep you alive because the odds of the job require it. That's the whole calculation.
lines.make_up: My estimate of you was wrong, {name}, and I've revised it. I'd like to start again.
lines.defend: That's statistically unfair, and simply untrue. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s away, and the party's odds of a good conversation have dropped sharply.
lines.friend_back: Ah, {name}'s back. My estimate of today has improved considerably.
lines.common_numbers: Twelve years of pricing how likely things are, very carefully. People who work with numbers find this world restful, because for once they hold still.
